name: Vigil helm library Mk 3 (VH3)
revision: 0.1 · 8 swappable VH3 helms on the line's 1.6 mm D-flat peg
description: Third-generation Vigil helm library (VH3): eight helms chosen for silhouette. VH3-01 Plummet (drop trooper: wide wrap visor under a brow ridge, flared jaw armour), VH3-02 Sightline (recon: twin chevron lenses, side optic pod), VH3-03 Ironclad (heavy assault: flat-topped, portcullis grille faceplate, hoses to a collar), VH3-04 Herald (officer: swept keel fin, comm mast, rank chevrons), VH3-05 Stillwater (sealed void globe with a domed window, collar and back pack), VH3-06 Deckhand (open-face crew cap with goggles and headset), VH3-07 Longsight (sniper: sallet tail, flip-down monocular), VH3-08 Grimward (scarred veteran: original relief death's-head faceplate, shattered fin). Every helm keeps the split-chevron glass and keel line, with the glass as a separate recessed surface for painting. Same 1.6 mm D-flat neck peg as VH-01..10 and VH2.

images.label: Fit test: each helm on the rifleman

buildNotes: Defined in tools/helms3.py (VH3 registry, signed-distance sculpt on tools/vh2.py building blocks); built on a 0.05 mm grid, print meshes not simplified or decimated.
Silhouette variety is measured (source/silhouettes.py: front/side silhouette IoU); see DESIGN-LOG.md.
Fit tested on the rifleman (source/fit.py): exact helm/figure and helm/backpack overlap volume after exosuit.helm_placement.
Display sheets colour the glass from each helm's own glass masks; the print files are one solid each.
limitations: Procedural sculpt at about 6 mm helm width: faces are stylised; damage is cut geometry. No STEP on this host (no FreeCAD). Printability is a heuristic screen (unified-CAD-MCP), not a test print.

mini.process: MSLA resin · 8K 7-inch class MSLA (e.g. Elegoo Saturn/Mars class)
